en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a villa-like building labeled "Grundschänke" in a lush, tree-filled foreground with wooden fencing. Behind it rise terraced vineyard hills. On the upper right hillside stands a prominent historic building identified as "Spitzhaus." The captions "Oberlößnitz." and "Grundschänke." are printed in red at the bottom, with a printer's line indicating "Brück & Sohn, Meissen."
